blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 DGFT Mandates Import Licensing for 4 Specific Silver Categories. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Restricts silver powder, grains, and 99.9% silver imports to valid DGFT authorization.
Silver Restriction: Requires DGFT Import Authorisation for silver powder (71061000), silver grains (71069110), 99.9% silver (71069120), and other silver (71069190).
Nominated Agencies: RBI and DGFT notified agencies, as well as IFSCA-notified jewellers on IIBX, must secure DGFT licences.
Forex Conservation: Designed to curb excessive silver imports and reduce trade deficit pressure.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on institutional financial products, interest margins, capital adequacy ratios, and digital payment infrastructure.
